text:
You need a developer who can guide you through building a commercial website even if you’re new to hiring online and not sure about the technical side.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can help turn your idea into a clear, professional website and explain the process in simple terms as we go.

One relevant project I built was a streaming chat widget for Quillstack in edtech. I developed the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streamed answers token by token, with the first token appearing in about 600 ms and supporting 30k chats a month.

If you’d like, I can help you define the pages, features, and the best path to launch your site.
